items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: He was playing with Mr. Johnny Brown's band. Mealy was playing in there.

ctx.x: Southern Pacific, he worked off a year, so. That's right. Yeah, that's right. Yeah, yeah.

What I'd pinciate for him was Chris Geller. He was playing with Mr. Johnny Brown's band. Mealy was playing in there. Johnny Brown was a violin player, but he tried to play clarinet. Maybe, he'd never make no clarinet, but that's the reason he got mealy bones. Mm-hmm. Now, man, you talkin' bout running Chris. Why them guys tried to run Chris? Well, you got to tempt him a guy sometimes. Try to hem him up, man. Oh, I don't understand it.
What would Chris play on a, on a advertisement when he buck with somebody? Would he play a fast number, or would he play a blues, or what would he play?
